in_sanskrit.name: Kumawat
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Kuma
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kumawat एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kumara’ meaning ‘Lord Kuma’ or ‘Lord of the Universe’. In Hindu mythology, Kumara is a name for Lord Shiva, a god of destruction.

in_hindi.name: कुमावत्
in_hindi.long_meaning: Kumawat is a Hindu name derived from the name of the goddess Kuma. The name is composed of two parts: 'Kuma' which refers to the goddess, and '-wat' which is a suffix indicating the feminine gender.

in_tamil.name: குமாவத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kumawat is a name of Tamil origin that translates to 'Goddess Kuma'. The name is derived from the Tamil word 'Kuma' which refers to the goddess, and the suffix '-ath' which signifies the feminine gender.

in_telugu.name: కూమావేద
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kumawat is a name of Telugu origin that translates to 'Goddess Kuma'. The name is derived from the Telugu word 'Kuma' which refers to the goddess, and the suffix '-vedu' which signifies the feminine gender.

in_marathi.name: Kumawat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumawat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kumara’ meaning ‘Lord Kuma’ or ‘Lord of the Universe’. In Hindu mythology, Kumara is a name for Lord Shiva, a god of destruction.
